method: Actual official checklist UI reads selected Football, Year 2026, then Donruss / Donruss and Panini / Obsidian. Each real Download Full Checklist action generated an a[download] data URI; its percent-encoded UTF-8 payload was decoded without content changes and retained as the original CSV bytes. The export filename and all original SPORT/YEAR/BRAND/PROGRAM cells independently identify the selection.
releaseQualification: First observation and the CSV Product Year do not establish a calendar release date. Numeric pack odds are not published in these exports.
inventoryCoverage: Both 2026 football brands and their sole visible program were reviewed. The broader all-sport inventory pass was interrupted when the browser provider became unavailable; no complete new all-sport inventory is claimed.
